pool_note: CORRECTED 2026-07-25 (second revision). A pool is bound to the API KEY, not selected by URL path — the earlier note in this file said the opposite and was wrong. Two keys hitting the identical root /v1/models return different catalogues: the Chinese Model Specials key returns the 13 ids in this file, the VIP Pools key returns 24 Claude/GPT/Grok ids. Path prefixes like /maxpools and /subpools are additional pools a key may or may not reach; /deepseek and /glm return 403 for every key tested, and /kimi, /free, /glm-free, /minimax return 503 for every key tested. This file describes what MAXPLUS_KEY_CHINESE serves. Note that MAXPLUS_API_KEY served exactly this list on 2026-07-24 and no longer does — its pool was reassigned in the dashboard, which is why the binding is recorded here explicitly rather than left implicit.
pool_addressing: Bound to the key. https://api.maxplus-ai.cc/v1 serves whatever pool the presented key belongs to.
